title: Circular Innovation in the Reuse of Vehicle Wash Water Using Permeable Concrete
content: One of the main environmental problems is the inadequate disposal of industrial wastewater, much of which is discharged untreated into the urban drainage system, affecting surface and groundwater bodies. Therefore, a treatment system based on permeable concrete, designed with local materials, is proposed. This allows for physical filtration of the water and its subsequent circular reuse in vehicle washing.
